$Comment: The Horseman's Steed: his black barded horse as a player's own mount. It never spawns in the world: on a server running Alec's Tamework, the Horseman's Reins drop puts one in the player's Tamework roster (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Reins_Chase.json runs /tw bonded grant with this role), and the Reins call it out and put it away (Server/Tamework/). A Variant of Hallows_Eve_Template_Horsemans_Steed, the pack's copy of the game's Template_Livestock (see that file for why it is a copy), carrying the game's tamed horse's own Modify (Tamed_Horse): IsMountable and its MountAnchor seat the rider as on any tamed horse. With Tamework, Server/Patchwork/Patches/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Steed_Patch.json swaps the template's interactions for Tamework's, so F rides it only for its owner (Server/Tamework/Interactions/Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Steed.json). Where it differs from the tamed horse: its Appearance (Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Steed, his horse without a rider), its own name, FlockArray empty so it never joins or brings a herd, and DropList Empty, since Tamework revives it rather than it being farmed. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.

Interactions.$Comment: Sets animations and delay before hit
Sets Hit shape and padding to allow effect to play and wait till animation is over
When NPC overrides the InteractionVars, this info in Template not applicable anymore
